title: 纳德拉就任 CEO 的第一封全员邮件（2014）
topic: 纳德拉就任 CEO 的第一封全员邮件（2014）

source.title: Satya Nadella email to employees on first day as CEO - Source
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 原文出自 Microsoft 微软 公开资料。
paragraphs: From: Satya Nadella To: All Employees Date: Feb. 4, 2014 Subject: RE: Satya Nadella – Microsoft’s New CEO

Today is a very humbling day for me. It reminds me of my very first day at Microsoft, 22 years ago. Like you, I had a choice about where to come to work. I came here because I believed Microsoft was the best company in the world. I saw then how clearly we empower people to do magical things with our creations and ultimately make the world a better place. I knew there was no better company to join if I wanted to make a difference. This is the very same inspiration that continues to drive me today.

It is an incredible honor for me to lead and serve this great company of ours. Steve and Bill have taken it from an idea to one of the greatest and most universally admired companies in the world. I’ve been fortunate to work closely with both Bill and Steve in my different roles at Microsoft, and as I step in as CEO, I’ve asked Bill to devote additional time to the company, focused on technology and products. I’m also looking forward to working with John Thompson as our new Chairman of the Board.
translations: 发件人：萨提亚·纳德拉 收件人：全体员工 日期：2014年2月4日 主题：回复：萨提亚·纳德拉——微软新CEO
今天对我而言意义非凡，也让我心怀谦逊。这让我想起 22 年前我在微软的第一天。和你们一样，当年我也可以选择去哪里工作。我来到这里，是因为我相信微软是世界上最好的公司。那时我清楚地看到，我们如何让人们借助微软的产品创造令人惊叹的成果，并最终让世界变得更好。我知道，如果想有所作为，没有比微软更值得加入的公司。这份信念至今仍激励着我。
能够领导并服务我们这家伟大的公司，我感到无比荣幸。史蒂夫和比尔已经将它从一个想法发展成世界上最伟大、最受普遍赞赏的公司之一。在微软的不同职位上，我有幸与比尔和史蒂夫密切合作，随着我接任CEO，我已经请比尔投入更多时间在公司，专注于技术和产品。我也期待与约翰·汤普森合作，担任我们的董事会主席。
fullTextParagraphs: From: Satya Nadella To: All Employees Date: Feb. 4, 2014 Subject: RE: Satya Nadella – Microsoft’s New CEO

Today is a very humbling day for me. It reminds me of my very first day at Microsoft, 22 years ago. Like you, I had a choice about where to come to work. I came here because I believed Microsoft was the best company in the world. I saw then how clearly we empower people to do magical things with our creations and ultimately make the world a better place. I knew there was no better company to join if I wanted to make a difference. This is the very same inspiration that continues to drive me today.

It is an incredible honor for me to lead and serve this great company of ours. Steve and Bill have taken it from an idea to one of the greatest and most universally admired companies in the world. I’ve been fortunate to work closely with both Bill and Steve in my different roles at Microsoft, and as I step in as CEO, I’ve asked Bill to devote additional time to the company, focused on technology and products. I’m also looking forward to working with John Thompson as our new Chairman of the Board.

While we have seen great success, we are hungry to do more. Our industry does not respect tradition — it only respects innovation. This is a critical time for the industry and for Microsoft. Make no mistake, we are headed for greater places — as technology evolves and we evolve with and ahead of it. Our job is to ensure that Microsoft thrives in a mobile and cloud-first world.
As we start a new phase of our journey together, I wanted to share some background on myself and what inspires and motivates me.

I am 46. I’ve been married for 22 years and we have 3 kids. And like anyone else, a lot of what I do and how I think has been shaped by my family and my overall life experiences. Many who know me say I am also defined by my curiosity and thirst for learning. I buy more books than I can finish. I sign up for more online courses than I can complete. I fundamentally believe that if you are not learning new things, you stop doing great and useful things. So family, curiosity and hunger for knowledge all define me.

I am here for the same reason I think most people join Microsoft — to change the world through technology that empowers people to do amazing things. I know it can sound hyperbolic — and yet it’s true. We have done it, we’re doing it today, and we are the team that will do it again.

I believe over the next decade computing will become even more ubiquitous and intelligence will become ambient. The coevolution of software and new hardware form factors will intermediate and digitize — many of the things we do and experience in business, life and our world. This will be made possible by an ever-growing network of connected devices, incredible computing capacity from the cloud, insights from big data, and intelligence from machine learning.

It will better connect us to our friends and families and help us see, express, and share our world in ways never before possible. It will enable businesses to engage customers in more meaningful ways.
I am here because we have unparalleled capability to make an impact.

In our early history, our mission was about the PC on every desk and home, a goal we have mostly achieved in the developed world. Today we’re focused on a broader range of devices. While the deal is not yet complete, we will welcome to our family Nokia devices and services and the new mobile capabilities they bring us.

As we look forward, we must zero in on what Microsoft can uniquely contribute to the world. The opportunity ahead will require us to reimagine a lot of what we have done in the past for a mobile and cloud-first world, and do new things.

We are the only ones who can harness the power of software and deliver it through devices and services that truly empower every individual and every organization. We are the only company with history and continued focus in building platforms and ecosystems that create broad opportunity.

Qi Lu captured it well in a recent meeting when he said that Microsoft uniquely empowers people to “do more.” This doesn’t mean that we need to do more things, but that the work we do empowers the world to do more of what they care about — get stuff done, have fun, communicate and accomplish great things. This is the core of who we are, and driving this core value in all that we do — be it the cloud or device experiences — is why we are here.
To paraphrase a quote from Oscar Wilde — we need to believe in the impossible and remove the improbable.

This starts with clarity of purpose and sense of mission that will lead us to imagine the impossible and deliver it. We need to prioritize innovation that is centered on our core value of empowering users and organizations to “do more.” We have picked a set of high-value activities as part of our One Microsoft strategy. And with every service and device launch going forward we need to bring more innovation to bear around these scenarios.

Finally, I truly believe that each of us must find meaning in our work. The best work happens when you know that it’s not just work, but something that will improve other people’s lives. This is the opportunity that drives each of us at this company.

Many companies aspire to change the world. But very few have all the elements required: talent, resources, and perseverance. Microsoft has proven that it has all three in abundance. And as the new CEO, I can’t ask for a better foundation.
Let’s build on this foundation together.

notes.phrase: It reminds me of my very first day at Microsoft, 22 years ago.
notes.meaning: 这让我想起22年前我在微软的第一天
notes.explain: 使用'remind me of'表达回忆，'very first day'强调初次经历
notes.example: This photograph reminds me of my very first day at university, ten years ago.

notes.phrase: I came here because I believed Microsoft was the best company in the world.
notes.meaning: 我来到这里是因为我相信微软是世界上最好的公司

notes.example: The founding team has taken our startup from a simple concept to a market leader in just five years.

scenario.title: Summarize Nadella’s first message as CEO
english: A new colleague asks what Satya Nadella said to Microsoft employees on his first day as CEO in 2014.
You explain the company’s stated purpose and the strategic challenge he highlighted for Microsoft.
Your colleague gets a concise summary based on the original email.
chinese: 一位新同事问，Satya Nadella 在 2014 年就任 CEO 的第一天对微软员工说了什么。
你概括他表达的公司使命，以及他指出的微软战略重点。
同事由此了解这封原始邮件的主要内容。

firstAttempt.prompt: 新同事问纳德拉在就任微软 CEO 的首封员工邮件中提出了什么使命和战略重点。请用两句英文概括原文。
firstAttempt.sample: Our mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Nadella said Microsoft would focus on a mobile-first, cloud-first world.
firstAttempt.rationale: 两句分别概括邮件中的使命表述和战略重点，不额外加入预算或营销安排。

words.meaning: 令人谦卑的，使人感到自己渺小的
words.example: Receiving this award was a humbling experience, considering all the talented people I work with.
words.translation: 获得这个奖项是一种谦卑的经历，考虑到我身边所有有才华的人。
words.note: 用于描述让人意识到自己局限或谦逊的经历

words.example: Our company policy aims to empower employees to make decisions that benefit both customers and the business.
words.translation: 我们公司的政策旨在赋权员工做出有利于客户和企业的决策。
words.note: 常用于描述给予他人权力或能力去完成某事

words.example: It's an incredible honor to be selected as the Employee of the Year for the third consecutive time.
words.translation: 连续第三次被评为年度员工是一种难以置信的荣誉。
words.note: 表示程度极高，超出预期

words.example: I was fortunate enough to work with some of the brightest minds in the industry during my internship.
words.translation: 实习期间，我有幸能与行业中最聪明的一些人共事。
words.note: 表示因好运而处于有利地位

words.example: When the CEO unexpectedly resigned, Jane stepped in as interim leader to guide the company through the transition.
words.translation: 当CEO意外辞职时，简接任临时领导，引导公司度过过渡期。
words.note: 表示在关键时刻接替某人的职位或角色

words.example: The company has decided to devote additional resources to developing sustainable packaging solutions.
words.translation: 公司决定投入额外资源开发可持续包装解决方案。
words.note: 表示将时间、精力等资源专门用于某事

structure.original: I saw then how clearly we empower people to do magical things with our creations and ultimately make the world a better place.
analysis: 主句是“I saw then”，后面的“how clearly we empower people…”是 saw 的宾语从句；then 表示“当时”。
宾语从句里，we 是主语，empower 和 make 是由 and 连接的并列谓语。empower people to do… 中，to do 是 people 的补足成分，说明赋予他们做什么的能力。
“with our creations”表示借助我们的产品；“make the world a better place”中 a better place 是宾语补足语，说明 make the world 成为什么。
structure.transfer: Technology helps our team give customers better tools, while cloud services let us support them at scale.

rewrite.bad: The mission is just about selling more software. The strategy can wait.
rewrite.good: Our mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Nadella said Microsoft would focus on a mobile-first, cloud-first world.
rewrite.translation: 我们的使命是赋能全球每个人和每个组织取得更大成就。纳德拉表示，微软将聚焦移动优先、云优先的世界。
rewrite.pattern: Our mission is to [mission]. Nadella said Microsoft would focus on [strategic direction].

cloze.prompt: Nadella said he joined Microsoft to help people do amazing things through ___.
cloze.why: 通过 technology 实现邮件中的使命表述。

cloze.prompt: The company needed to thrive in a mobile-first and cloud-first ___.
cloze.why: 保留 2014 年邮件中当时的战略说法。

cloze.prompt: The company needed to ___ in a mobile-first and cloud-first world.
cloze.why: thrive in 表示在某种市场环境中发展良好。

dictation.text: Alex Chen, newly appointed Director of Operations, needs to send his first company-wide email introducing himself and outlining his vision for the department.
dictation.label: 听写 1 · 模拟新任负责人发全员邮件
dictation.why: Alex 和部门愿景属于模拟场景；微软这封邮件写的是 Satya Nadella 接任 CEO。

dictation.text: The marketing team insists on highlighting innovative approaches, while the finance department emphasizes budget constraints, creating conflicting priorities for the email content.
dictation.label: 听写 2 · 不同部门对邮件重点的关注
dictation.why: 创新与预算代表不同关注点。微软这封全员邮件重点说明使命和战略方向。

apply.prompt: 向新同事概括 Nadella 在首封微软全员邮件中提出的使命和方向。
apply.sample: Nadella said Microsoft was here to change the world through technology and help people achieve more in a mobile-first, cloud-first world.

translationPractice.prompt: 微软希望通过技术改变世界。
translationPractice.answer: Microsoft is here to change the world through technology.

translationPractice.prompt: 技术可以帮助人们取得更多成果。
translationPractice.answer: Technology can empower people to achieve more.

translationPractice.prompt: 公司需要在移动优先、云优先的环境中持续发展。
translationPractice.answer: The company needed to thrive in a mobile-first and cloud-first world.

choice.prompt: 新同事问纳德拉在就任微软 CEO 的首封员工邮件中提出了什么使命和战略重点。请用两句英文概括原文。
options: Microsoft’s mission is to sell more software, and it should focus on desktop computers.
Nadella said Microsoft was here to change the world through technology that empowers people to do amazing things. He said the company needed to thrive in a mobile-first and cloud-first world.
The message confirms some changes, but I would not assume details about the team that it does not mention.
choice.why: 第一句概括邮件中的使命，第二句保留当时的战略重点，不替换成后来常用的使命口号。

output.prompt: （情景练习）你在新人介绍会上介绍一个为教师开发移动学习工具的团队。请用英文说明团队希望用技术帮助谁、希望他们实现什么，以及产品需要适应怎样的技术环境。
output.sample: We’re here to make learning more accessible through technology. We want to empower teachers and students to achieve more, so our product needs to thrive in a mobile-first and cloud-first world.
check: 是否说明团队想用技术解决什么问题？
是否说明希望帮助谁实现什么？
是否把移动端与云端作为产品工作的重点？
